target.description: Echo of the requested review target; the dispatcher enforces it (REVIEW_BINDING_MISMATCH).

reviewed_sha256.description: Echo of the hash of the artifact under review; enforced by the dispatcher.

diff_sha256.description: Echo of the implementation diff hash; required by the dispatcher for target implement.

draft_sha256.description: Echo of the writer draft hash; enforced once writer drafts exist (step 5).

verdict.description: pass only when there are no findings; escalate when any finding is dangerous.

findings.description: Defects only. Empty when the change is correct.
